title: Hotspots
tagline: Experience seamless Wi-Fi access with our crypto-powered captive portal! Pay for subscriptions or make donations using your favorite cryptocurrencies. Enjoy secure, transparent transactions and instant internet access. #Crypto #Blockchain #WiFi #Innovation
description: Hotspots is a cutting-edge captive portal solution built on blockchain technology, enabling users to share their Wi-Fi networks securely. Through Hotspots, users can easily subscribe or donate to the owner of the portal, ensuring a seamless and decentralized experience. Whether you want to offer or access Wi-Fi, Hotspots leverages the power of blockchain to create a transparent and reliable platform for all parties involved.
how_its_made: It was built using next js  as the frontend/ back end.  it uses World coin for verification.  It uses alchemy Account kit for account abstraction and gas subsidy.  It users goldys to for graphql. EAS for portal verifications and Pyth in the smart contracts to ensure users pay the right fees
